response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad, hands-on software engineering across web, backend, mobile and embedded systems, with genuine open-source credibility (GISCollective founder, multiple D-language libraries, conference talks) and solid Linux/DevOps exposure — all relevant to an open-source-focused consultancy. However, the role is an executive-level leadership position and his track record is that of a senior/staff individual contributor: no evidence of line management, team leadership, technical project management, or client-facing architecture advisory at scale. Critically, the posting requires German at C1 minimum for advising clients and leading a German-speaking team, and he lists only basic German. Combined with the absence of UML/formal modeling, requirements management, IT security/compliance experience, and Python, the profile falls short of the core requirements despite strong engineering depth.
strengths: Deep, versatile 15+ year engineering track record across many stacks and domains
Strong open-source ethos: founded and maintains OSS platform, libraries, conference talks
Proven mentoring/teaching ability via workshops, courses, and dojos
concerns: German only at basic level vs. required C1 for client advisory
No formal leadership, line-management, or project-management experience
No demonstrated UML modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance work

key_factors.factor: Broad senior engineering and open-source depth
